'''Kohvrekhar''', along with his clan-brother [[Ghazhak]], was one of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] [[Noghri/Legends|Noghri]] bodyguards.

==History==
After the [[Duel on Cloud City/Legends|duel]] on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] between Vader and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], the two Noghri were tasked with locating Luke's lost [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and severed hand. After finding both in the possession of a group of [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaughts]], Vader himself relieved the creatures of their prize and the Noghri accompanied him to [[Mount Tantiss/Legends|Mount Tantiss]] to deliver the items to [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].

In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Kohvrekhar was ordered by Vader to shadow [[Wrenga Jixton|Jix]], an Imperial [[Spy/Legends|spy]], to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in order to ensure Jix's mission was successful. Kohvrekhar and his team were to disguise themselves as [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]]s and ensure that [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] was kept alive.
